technical_and_design_decisions: Design and implement REST endpoints in Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) server for uploading and dynamically registering module coordinates.
Refactor ModuleRegistryPopulator and underlying ModuleRegistry services to support dynamic module registration backed by persistent storage/repository instead of static bootstrap initializers.
Extend the Spring Cloud Data Flow Shell CLI with commands for uploading custom module binaries/artifacts and registering module URIs.

Port the 6 specified legacy Spring XD modules (jms, mail, mongo, mqtt, reactor-ip, stdout) into Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Cloud Stream Modules repositories, converting them into Spring Boot / Spring Cloud Stream apps.
assumptions: The developer has full access to repository codebases (Spring Cloud Data Flow server/shell, spring-cloud-stream-modules, spring-cloud-stream).
Standard CI/CD infrastructure, test harnesses, and repository artifacts (e.g., Maven/Nexus/Artifactory) are already established.
Module migration involves adapting Spring XD integration flows to Spring Cloud Stream binder abstractions and updating dependencies and unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Technical Design & REST API Specification for Dynamic Module Upload
activities.activity_description: Analyze user stories U1 and U2, design REST API contracts for module upload and dynamic registration, and architect changes to the ModuleRegistry backend.

activities.activity_name: s-c-d Server Backend Implementation for Module Upload & Registry
activities.activity_description: Implement REST controllers, upload services, artifact storage handling, and dynamic module registration logic in spring-cloud-dataflow-server.
Add new CLI commands and options in spring-cloud-dataflow-shell to allow users to register and upload modules via REST API.
Refactor hardcoded bootstrap module registration (ModuleRegistryPopulator) to enable dynamic runtime updates and state persistence.

activities.activity_name: Port Spring XD Modules (JMS, Mail, Mongo, MQTT, Reactor-IP, Stdout)
activities.activity_description: Migrate, refactor, and write unit tests for jms, mail, and mongo modules into s-c-s-m, and mqtt, reactor-ip, and stdout modules into s-c-s repositories.
Conduct integration testing of custom module uploads, dynamic registry updates, and stream/task execution using migrated modules.
Document new REST API endpoints, shell commands, and module registry updates; prepare PRs and release notes.
